pipeline.use_chunk_pipeline: null=auto (based on file size), true=force chunk pipeline, false=force entire file pipeline
pipeline.file_size_threshold_mb: Files larger than this (in MB) use CHUNK pipeline when use_chunk_pipeline is null

chunk_settings.chunk_size: Number of lines per chunk for CHUNK pipeline
chunk_settings.parallel_chunks: true=process chunks in parallel, false=process sequentially
chunk_settings.chunk_workers: null=auto (based on CPU count), or specify number of parallel workers
chunk_settings.min_chunks_for_parallel: Minimum number of chunks required to use parallel processing

drain3_settings.batch_size: Lines per batch when feeding to Drain3
drain3_settings.similarity_threshold: Drain3 similarity threshold (0.0-1.0). Lower=more templates, higher=fewer templates
drain3_settings.depth: Drain3 parse tree depth. Higher=more specific templates
drain3_settings.max_children: Maximum children per node in Drain3 parse tree

output.output_dir: null=use script directory/output, or specify custom path
output.levels_to_process: Log levels to process: E=Error, W=Warning, I=Information, UNKNOWN=Unknown

preprocessing.remove_timestamps: true=remove timestamps from log lines before processing
preprocessing.timestamp_patterns: Regex patterns for timestamp removal (applied in order)

frequency_settings.high_freq_cumulative_threshold: Pareto threshold (0.0-1.0). Used as fallback when rare_max_lines_per_template is null
frequency_settings.enable_tiered_error_output: true=create separate files for high-freq and rare errors
frequency_settings.rare_absolute_max_size: null=disabled, or integer. Templates with size <= N are always classified as rare
frequency_settings.rare_max_lines_per_template: Templates with <= this many log lines are rare errors; > this many are high-frequency. Default: 15. Set to null to use Pareto threshold instead

chunk_scaling.auto_scale_chunks: true=auto-adjust chunk_size, parallel, and workers based on file size. false=use fixed chunk_settings values
chunk_scaling.tiers: Ordered list of {max_mb, chunk_size, parallel, max_workers}. First tier where file_size <= max_mb wins. Larger chunks = fewer in-memory chunks = less RAM pressure on 16GB pods
chunk_scaling.fallback: Used for files larger than every tier. Sequential with very large chunks to cap memory

_notes._output_files: All output files now include ALL log lines for each template (no sampling or truncation)
